rv.q: I can probably sum-up my reaction to it, as: “What an absolute load of hokum — I loved every minute”.
The Scaring deserves to possess many more audiences before it ghosts us for good.
The freedom and silliness of a sketch show with the scale to make its ridiculous ideas feel spectacular.
The Scaring proves to be the perfect vehicle for all three of the group to showcase their combined comedic prowess.

cn.t: Critics praise this comedy-horror sketch show for nailing a difficult genre with silly freedom and slick staging. The ridiculous premise and spectacular execution deliver consistent laughs in what reviewers call delightful hokum.
